title: Immunostaining of phospho-RIPK3 in L929 cells, murine yolk sacs, ceca, and small intestines
protocol: Soak NEST Scientific cover glasses in chromic acid overnight.
Rinse cover glasses with fresh water the next day.
Store washed cover glasses in 75% ethanol long-term if needed.
Dip a single cover glass into 95%–100% ethanol using forceps.
Blot off excess ethanol and wave through a flame until extinguished.
Drop sterile cover glass into one well of a 12-well plate.
Add 500 μL of PBS to each well, immersing the cover glass completely.
Incubate plate in a 37°C incubator for at least 30 minutes.
Remove PBS and add 500 μL of 0.1% Gelatin Solution to each well.
Incubate plate in a 37°C incubator for 10 minutes.
Wash once with 500 μL of PBS.
Seed 5 × 10^5 L929 cells in each well and incubate overnight at 37°C.
Replace medium the next day with fresh medium containing TNF (20 ng/mL) and Z-VAD (20 μM).
At indicated time points, aspirate medium and wash wells once with 500 μL of PBS.
Add 500 μL of 4% PFA to each well for fixation at room temperature (25°C) for 15 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Add 500 μL of 0.25% TritonX-100 to each well and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Add 500 μL of 5% BSA to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
On a Parafilm in a light-protective black western blot incubation box, add 50 μL of 2.7 μg/mL phospho-RIPK3 antibody in 5% BSA for each sample.
Use a syringe needle bent at the tip and a tweezer to take cover glasses out of the 12-well plate.
Place the cover glass face down on the antibody droplet.
Incubate at 4°C overnight.
Place a 35-mm dish of PBS in the incubation box for moist condition if needed.
Wash the cover glasses with 500 μL of PBS three times for 5 minutes each.
Prepare the staining solution by adding 1:200 Goat anti-mouse IgG (H+L) Alexa Fluor 568 Antibody and 1 μg/mL Hoechst to 5% BSA.
Change Parafilm in the black incubation box.
Add 50 μL of the staining solution onto the new Parafilm for each sample.
Place the cover glasses face down onto the antibody droplet.
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Place the cover glasses back into the 12-well plate, face up.
Wash the cover glasses with 500 μL of PBS three times for 5 min each.
Add 9 μL of ProLong® Gold Antifade Reagent onto CITOGLAS slides.
Carefully place the cover glasses face down onto the droplets.
Seal the rim of the cover glasses completely using nail polish to prevent any leak.
Place the sealed slides in a light-protective slide holder to dry overnight at room temperature.
Acquire images using Zeiss LSM 880+Airyscan laser-scanning confocal microscope.
Select Alexa Fluor 568 for phospho-RIPK3 and Hoechst 33342 for Hoechst.
Take a bright-field image to show the overall morphology of the cells.
Add 1–2 female(s) in estrus into each stud male’s cage at 9:00 PM.
Examine females for vaginal plugs and separate them from the males at 9:00 AM the next morning.
Set the morning when a vaginal plug is found as embryonic day 0.5 (E0.5).
At 9:00 AM on E10.5, euthanize pregnant females via CO2 exposure for at least 5 minutes until no breathing is observed.
Perform toe pinch to ensure death.
If necessary, perform cervical dislocation as a secondary method of euthanasia.
Collect yolk sacs before Casp8−/− embryos are resorbed.
Mount yolk sacs on adhesion microscope slides.
Allow the slides to dry at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Draw a circle around the yolk sac with a Super PAP Pen to confine reagents.
Fix the yolk sacs by adding 50 μL of 4% PFA in PBS and incubating at 4°C for 4 hours.
Aspirate 4% PFA from the slides.
Permeabilize the cells by adding 50 μL of permeabilization buffer and incubating at room temperature for 45 minutes.
Discard the permeabilization buffer.
Add 50 μL of blocking solution containing 2% goat serum in PBS and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Aspirate the blocking solution.
Add 50 μL of the primary antibody cocktail.
Incubate at 4°C overnight.
Wash the slides with 50 mL of PBS three times for 5 min each.
Incubate for 1 h in the dark at room temperature with 50 μL of the secondary antibody cocktail.
Aspirate the secondary antibody solution.
Add 50 μL of 1 μg/mL Hoechst in PBS.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature in the dark.
Wash the slides with 50 mL of PBS three times for 5 min each.
Add 9 μL of ProLong® Gold Antifade Reagent onto the yolk sac on the slide.
Place one cover glass onto the droplet carefully.
Seal the rim of the cover glass with nail polish.
Place the slide in a light-protective slide holder to dry overnight at room temperature.
Inject mice intravenously with murine TNFα at 300 μg per kg body weight prepared in endotoxin-free saline.
Harvest ceca at 8 hours post-injection and fix them in 4% PFA overnight.
Clean feces after fixation of the ceca.
Treat Setdb1fl/fl mice and Setdb1fl/fl Vil-CreERT2 mice with one dose of 400 mg/kg tamoxifen by gavage.
Collect small intestines at day 4 post-tamoxifen injection.
Clean feces from the collected small intestines.
Roll up the small intestine and fix tissues in 4% PFA.
Transfer cecum and small intestine samples to a semi-enclosed benchtop tissue processor for dehydration.
Incubate samples in 50%, 70%, and 80% ethanol in water (v/v) for 25 minutes each.
Incubate samples in 95% ethanol in water (v/v) twice for 15 minutes each.
Incubate samples in 100% ethanol twice for 30 minutes each.
Incubate samples in an ethanol and xylene mixture (1:1 v/v) for 30 minutes.
Incubate samples in xylene twice for 20 minutes each.
Incubate samples in paraplast tissue embedding medium twice at 60°C for 1.5 hours each.
Transfer infiltrated tissues into the embedding workstation at a working temperature of 60°C and embed them with an appropriately sized embedding mold.
Trim the tissue-embedding paraffin blocks and section the tissues to a thickness of 5 μm on an RM2016 microtome.
Float the tissue sections in a tissue section flotation bath.
Pick the tissue sections from the water bath using CITOGLAS slides.
Dry the slides on a 42°C slide drier.
Dry the slides further in a 56°C oven.
Incubate the slides in xylene for 10 minutes.
Repeat the incubation of the slides in xylene twice.
Move the slides to 100% ethanol and incubate for 10 minutes.
Repeat the incubation of the slides in 100% ethanol once.
Proceed with the slides in 90% ethanol in water (v/v) for 5 minutes.
Incubate the slides in 80% ethanol in water (v/v) for 5 minutes.
Incubate the slides in 70% ethanol in water (v/v) for 5 minutes.
Wash the slides in ddH2O for 5 minutes three times.
Place the slides in a pressure cooker containing antigen retrieval buffer, ensuring the buffer covers the whole tissue.
Heat the pressure cooker on an induction stove at 1800 W.
Let the cooker vent for 1.5 minutes and then turn off the stove.
Allow the cooker to cool down to room temperature.
Use a Super PAP Pen to draw a circle around the tissue after antigen retrieval.
Ensure all reagents and antibodies except the washing solution are added within the circled area on the slides.
Wash the slides in wash buffer on a shaker at 55 rpm for 5 min.
Repeat the washing step twice.
Incubate the slides in BLOXALL Blocking Solution at room temperature for 10 min.
Wash the slides using washing solution on a shaker for 5 min at 55 rpm three times.
Add 50 μL of 2.5% horse serum to the tissue within the circle.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Remove excessive serum from the slides.
Add 50 μL of phospho-RIPK3 (T231 + S232) antibody in 2.5% horse serum (6.75 μg/mL for ceca and 1.35 μg/mL for small intestines).
Put the slides into a slide rack.
Incubate at 4°C for 12 h.
Place a small dish of water inside the slide rack to prevent drying out.
After phospho-RIPK3 antibody incubation, place the slide rack on the benchtop for about 30 min to warm to room temperature.
Wash the slides using wash buffer on a shaker at 55 rpm for 5 min.
Repeat the wash step twice.
Incubate the slides with 50 μL of biotinylated horse anti-mouse/rabbit IgG secondary antibody at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash the slides using wash buffer on a shaker at 55 rpm for 5 min.
Repeat the wash step twice.
Incubate with VECTASTAIN Elite ABC Reagent at room temperature for 30 min.
After three washes using wash buffer on a shaker at 55 rpm for 5 min each, mix the ImmPACT DAB EqV solutions as instructed by the manufacturer.
Incubate the slides until appropriate stain intensity develops.
Use ddH2O to wash the slides 3 times for 5 min each on a shaker at 55 rpm at room temperature.
Counterstain the slides with 50 μL of Hematoxylin for 1.5 min at room temperature.
Wash the slides 3 times with ddH2O for 10 s per wash after counterstaining.
Incubate the slides in 0.08% ammonia for 6 s and then wash 3 times with ddH2O for 10 s per wash.
Dehydrate the slides with 80% ethanol (v/v) for 1 min, followed by 90% ethanol for 1 min, 100% ethanol for 1 min twice, and 100% xylene for 1 min twice.
Add permanent mounting medium neutral balsam to the sections.
Cover the sections with cover glasses and press gently to remove bubbles.
Let the slides dry in a fume hood at room temperature for 12 h.
